q: 60वें ज्ञानपीठ पुरस्कार से सम्मानित प्रसिद्ध कवि आर. वैरामुथु किस भारतीय भाषा के विख्यात साहित्यकार हैं?
e: R. Vairamuthu is an acclaimed Tamil poet and lyricist honoured with the 60th Jnanpith Award. Exam Boosters: (1) Earlier Tamil Jnanpith laureates include Akilan (1975) and Jayakanthan (2002). (2) Jnanpith Award is given for literature in any of the 22 Eighth Schedule languages plus English.
qe: Renowned poet R. Vairamuthu, who was conferred the 60th Jnanpith Award, is a celebrated literary figure in which Indian language?

q: कौन-सा उच्च-तुंगता वाला केंद्र शासित प्रदेश भारत का पहला प्रमाणित "जैविक केंद्र शासित प्रदेश" (Organic UT) बना?
e: Ladakh became India's first Organic Union Territory, promoting chemical-free traditional cultivation of barley, buckwheat, apricots, and sea buckthorn. Exam Boosters: (1) Leh and Kargil are the two districts of UT Ladakh.
qe: Which high-altitude Union Territory became India's first certified "Organic Union Territory"?

q: कनाडाई कवयित्री और क्लासिकिस्ट ऐनी कार्सन को अक्टूबर 2026 में किस प्रतिष्ठित अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सम्मान से नवाजा गया?
e: Anne Carson was awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature by the Swedish Academy in October 2026. Exam Boosters: (1) Her noted works include "Autobiography of Red" and "Eros the Bittersweet".
qe: Canadian poet and classicist Anne Carson received which prestigious international honour in October 2026?

q: 22 सितंबर 2026 को एकता नगर (गुजरात) में आयोजित 72वें राष्ट्रीय फिल्म पुरस्कारों में दिग्गज अभिनेता अनंत नाग को किस सम्मान से अलंकृत किया गया?
e: Anant Nag received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award (for 2024) on 22 September 2026 at the 72nd National Film Awards in Ekta Nagar.
qe: At the 72nd National Film Awards held on 22 September 2026 at Ekta Nagar (Gujarat), veteran actor Anant Nag was honoured with:

q:
अक्टूबर 2026 की निम्नलिखित पर्यावरणीय उपलब्धियों और उनके स्थानों के युग्मों पर विचार कीजिए:
1. भारत का पहला प्लास्टिक-मुक्त तेल टर्मिनल — जवाहर द्वीप (महाराष्ट्र)
2. बाघ पुनर्वास कार्यक्रम — बक्सा टाइगर रिज़र्व (पश्चिम बंगाल)
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से युग्म सही सुमेलित है/हैं?
e: Both pairs are accurate. Jawahar Dweep near Mumbai became India's first Plastic-Free Oil Terminal in Oct 2026, and Buxa Tiger Reserve in West Bengal launched a Tiger Reintroduction Program in Oct 2026.
qe:
Consider the following pairs of October 2026 environmental milestones and their locations:
1. India's first Plastic-Free Oil Terminal — Jawahar Dweep (Maharashtra)
2. Tiger Reintroduction Program — Buxa Tiger Reserve (West Bengal)
Which of the above pairs is/are correctly matched?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में भारतीय तटरक्षक बल ने SAREX-2026 का 12वाँ संस्करण आयोजित किया। संक्षिप्त नाम "SAREX" का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e: SAREX stands for National Maritime Search and Rescue Exercise, conducted biennially by the Indian Coast Guard to test maritime mass rescue coordination.
qe: In October 2026, the Indian Coast Guard conducted the 12th edition of SAREX-2026. What does the acronym "SAREX" stand for?

q: यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल "फतेहपुर सीकरी" (बुलंद दरवाजा, पंचमहल, सलीम चिश्ती की दरगाह) उत्तर प्रदेश के किस जिले में स्थित है?
e: Fatehpur Sikri (built by Emperor Akbar in 1571–1585) lies in Agra district, UP. Exam Boosters: (1) UP has 3 UNESCO World Heritage Sites—Taj Mahal (1983), Agra Fort (1983), and Fatehpur Sikri (1986).
qe: Which city of Uttar Pradesh is famous for the historic "Fatehpur Sikri" complex (Buland Darwaza, Panch Mahal, Tomb of Salim Chishti), a UNESCO World Heritage Site?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा जिला भारत में आँवला का अग्रणी उत्पादक है और आँवला उत्पादों हेतु ODOP पहचान रखता है?
e: Pratapgarh district of UP is India's largest producer of Amla. Exam Boosters: (1) Malihabad (Lucknow) is famous for Dasheri Mango; Saharanpur & Muzaffarnagar for sugarcane/jaggery; Kannauj for Attar.
qe: Which district of Uttar Pradesh is the leading producer of Amla (Indian Gooseberry) in India and holds the GI/ODOP identity for Amla products?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश में "केंद्रीय उपोष्ण बागवानी संस्थान" (CISH) कहाँ स्थित है?
e: ICAR–Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture (CISH) is located at Rehmankhera, Lucknow. Exam Boosters: (1) Indian Grassland and Fodder Research Institute (IGFRI) is in Jhansi. (2) Indian Institute of Handloom Technology (IIHT) is in Varanasi.
qe: Where is the "Central Institute for Subtropical Horticulture" (केंद्रीय उपोष्ण बागवानी संस्थान) located in Uttar Pradesh?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा ताप विद्युत संयंत्र सोनभद्र जिले ("भारत की ऊर्जा राजधानी") में स्थित है?
o: ओबरा एवं अनपरा ताप विद्युत संयंत्र
e: Obra, Anpara, Rihand, and Singrauli thermal power stations are in Sonbhadra. Harduaganj is in Aligarh, Parichha is in Jhansi, and Panki is in Kanpur.
qe: Which of the following thermal power stations in Uttar Pradesh is located in Sonbhadra district (known as the "Energy Capital of India")?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा ऐतिहासिक/सांस्कृतिक स्थल अपने जिले से सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e: Piprahwa (identified with ancient Kapilvastu, where Buddha's relics were found) is located in Siddharthnagar district, NOT Bahraich. Options A, B, and C are all accurately matched.
qe: Which of the following UP historical/cultural sites is NOT correctly matched with its district?

q: "स्वराज मेरा जन्मसिद्ध अधिकार है और मैं इसे लेकर रहूँगा"—यह प्रसिद्ध देशभक्ति नारा किसने दिया था?
e: Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak popularized this slogan during the Home Rule Movement (1916). Exam Boosters: (1) Tilak authored "Gita Rahasya" (in Mandalay Jail) and "The Arctic Home in the Vedas".
qe: Who gave the famous patriotic slogan "Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it" (स्वराज मेरा जन्मसिद्ध अधिकार है और मैं इसे लेकर रहूँगा)?

q: 13 अप्रैल 1919 को अमृतसर में "जलियाँवाला बाग हत्याकांड" किस दमनकारी ब्रिटिश कानून के विरोध प्रदर्शन के दौरान हुआ था?
e: People had gathered peacefully on Baisakhi (13 April 1919) to protest the Rowlatt Act ("No Dalil, No Vakil, No Appeal") and the arrest of Dr. Saifuddin Kitchlew and Dr. Satyapal, when Brig. Gen. Reginald Dyer opened fire. Rabindranath Tagore renounced his Knighthood in protest.
qe: The "Jallianwala Bagh Massacre" occurred in Amritsar on 13 April 1919 during protests against which repressive British law?

q: 1892 में ब्रिटिश हाउस ऑफ कॉमन्स के लिए चुने जाने वाले प्रथम भारतीय तथा भारत की प्रथम प्रति व्यक्ति राष्ट्रीय आय (₹20) की गणना करने वाले नेता कौन थे?
e: Dadabhai Naoroji ("Grand Old Man of India") presided over INC thrice (1886, 1893, 1906) and propounded the Drain of Wealth theory in "Poverty and Un-British Rule in India".
qe: Who was the first Indian to be elected to the British House of Commons (1892, Finsbury Central) and who calculated India's first per capita national income (₹20)?

q: केशव चंद्र सेन से प्रेरित होकर 1867 में बंबई में "प्रार्थना समाज" की स्थापना किस समाज सुधारक ने की थी, जिसे बाद में न्यायमूर्ति एम. जी. रानाडे ने लोकप्रिय बनाया?
e: Dr. Atmaram Pandurang founded Prarthana Samaj in 1867 in Bombay, advocating monotheism, widow remarriage, and caste reform. Exam Boosters: (1) Gopal Hari Deshmukh was called "Lokahitawadi". (2) H. V. Derozio led the Young Bengal Movement.
qe: Which social reformer founded the "Prarthana Samaj" in Bombay in 1867 (inspired by Keshab Chandra Sen), later popularized by Justice Mahadev Govind Ranade?

q:
1940 के दशक की निम्नलिखित राजनीतिक घटनाओं को सही कालानुक्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए:
1. क्रिप्स मिशन
2. अगस्त प्रस्ताव
3. शिमला सम्मेलन / वेवेल योजना
4. शाही भारतीय नौसेना (RIN) विद्रोह
e: Chronology: (2) August Offer (August 1940, Lord Linlithgow) → (1) Cripps Mission (March 1942) → (3) Wavell Plan / Shimla Conference (June 1945) → (4) Royal Indian Navy Mutiny (February 1946, HMIS Talwar, Bombay).
qe:
Arrange the following constitutional/political events of the 1940s in correct chronological order:
1. Cripps Mission (क्रिप्स मिशन)
2. August Offer (अगस्त प्रस्ताव)
3. Shimla Conference / Wavell Plan (शिमला सम्मेलन / वेवेल योजना)
4. Royal Indian Navy (RIN) Mutiny (शाही भारतीय नौसेना विद्रोह)

q: 86वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 2002 द्वारा जोड़ा गया अनुच्छेद 51A(k) का कौन-सा मौलिक कर्तव्य माता-पिता और अभिभावकों पर लागू होता है?
o: 6 से 14 वर्ष के अपने बच्चे/प्रतिपाल्य को शिक्षा के अवसर प्रदान करना
राष्ट्रीय महत्व के स्मारकों की रक्षा करना
आपातकाल में देश की रक्षा करना
e: Article 51A(k) is the 11th Fundamental Duty, requiring parents/guardians to provide educational opportunities to children between 6 and 14 years of age.
qe: Which Fundamental Duty under Article 51A(k)—added by the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002—applies to parents and guardians?
oe: Providing opportunities for education to their child/ward aged 6 to 14 years
Defending the country during national emergency

q: विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग अधिनियम, 1956 के अंतर्गत स्थापित कौन-सा निकाय भारत में उच्च शिक्षा के मानकों के समन्वय, निर्धारण व अनुरक्षण के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
e: UGC (statutory body since 1956, headquarters New Delhi) regulates university education standards and disburses grants to universities and colleges. Exam Boosters: (1) NEP 2020 proposes replacing UGC, AICTE, and NCTE with a single umbrella regulator—HECI (Higher Education Commission of India).
qe: Which body—established under the University Grants Commission Act, 1956—is responsible for coordination, determination, and maintenance of standards in higher education in India?

q: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत भारत के राष्ट्रपति लोक महत्व के किसी विधि या तथ्य के प्रश्न पर सर्वोच्च न्यायालय से परामर्श मांग सकते हैं?
e: Article 143 confers Advisory Jurisdiction on the Supreme Court; the opinion tendered by the SC is advisory and NOT strictly binding on the President.
qe: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution can the President of India seek the advisory opinion of the Supreme Court on any question of law or fact of public importance?

q: भारत में क्रमशः (i) लोकसभा, (ii) राज्यसभा तथा (iii) ग्राम पंचायत का चुनाव लड़ने के लिए न्यूनतम आयु सीमा कितनी है?
e: Minimum ages: Lok Sabha & State Assembly = 25 yrs; Rajya Sabha & State Legislative Council = 30 yrs; Panchayat & Municipality = 21 yrs; President, Vice-President & Governor = 35 yrs; Voting age = 18 yrs.
qe: What is the minimum age required to contest elections for (i) Lok Sabha, (ii) Rajya Sabha, and (iii) Gram Panchayat respectively in India?

q: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम ने "संपत्ति के अधिकार" को मौलिक अधिकार से हटाकर (अनुच्छेद 19(1)(f) व 31 को निरस्त कर) अनुच्छेद 300A के तहत विधिक अधिकार बना दिया?
e: The 44th Amendment Act, 1978 (Janata Government under Morarji Desai) moved Right to Property to Part XII under Article 300A ("No person shall be deprived of his property save by authority of law").
qe: Which Constitutional Amendment Act abolished the "Right to Property" as a Fundamental Right (deleting Articles 19(1)(f) and 31) and placed it as a constitutional legal right under Article 300A?

q: पूर्णतः भारत के क्षेत्राधिकार (PoK को छोड़कर) में उत्तराखंड राज्य में स्थित सर्वोच्च पर्वत शिखर कौन-सा है?
e: Nanda Devi (7,816 m, Uttarakhand) is the highest peak located entirely inside India. (Kanchenjunga, 8,586 m, lies on the India–Nepal border in Sikkim; K2/Godwin-Austen, 8,611 m, lies in PoK.)
qe: Which is the highest mountain peak located entirely within the territory of India (excluding PoK), situated in Uttarakhand?

q: भारत वन स्थिति रिपोर्ट (ISFR) के अनुसार प्रतिशत की दृष्टि से सर्वाधिक वनावरण वाला राज्य तथा कुल क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से सर्वाधिक वनावरण वाला राज्य क्रमशः कौन-से हैं?
e: Mizoram has the highest forest cover as a percentage of state area (>84%), while Madhya Pradesh has the largest total forest area in India, followed by Arunachal Pradesh and Chhattisgarh.
qe: Which Indian state has the highest forest cover by PERCENTAGE of its geographical area as well as which state has the largest forest cover by TOTAL AREA (ISFR)?

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, 2001–2011 के दौरान भारत के किस एकमात्र राज्य ने ऋणात्मक दशकीय जनसंख्या वृद्धि दर (−0.58%) दर्ज की?
e: Nagaland was the only Indian state to register negative decadal population growth (−0.58%) in 2001–2011. Meghalaya recorded the highest decadal growth rate (+27.95%) among states.
qe: According to Census 2011, which state of India recorded a NEGATIVE decadal population growth rate (−0.58%) during 2001–2011?

q: भारत में "हरित क्रांति" (1966–67) के परिणामस्वरूप मुख्यतः किन दो खाद्यान्न फसलों के उत्पादन में अभूतपूर्व वृद्धि हुई?
e: Led by M. S. Swaminathan (Father of Indian Green Revolution) using Norman Borlaug's High Yielding Variety (HYV) seeds, Green Revolution dramatically boosted Wheat (especially in Punjab, Haryana, Western UP) and Rice production.
qe: In India, the "Green Revolution" (1966–67) primarily resulted in a dramatic jump in the production of which two foodgrain crops?

q: भारतीय कृषि में व्यापक रूप से देखी जाने वाली "प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी" (Disguised Unemployment) क्या है?
o: बुवाई और कटाई के बीच मौसमी अंतराल से उत्पन्न बेरोजगारी
आवश्यकता से अधिक श्रमिकों का कार्यरत होना, जिससे अतिरिक्त श्रमिकों की सीमांत उत्पादकता शून्य हो
एक नौकरी से दूसरी नौकरी बदलते समय अस्थायी बेरोजगारी
स्वचालन द्वारा फैक्ट्री श्रमिकों के विस्थापन से बेरोजगारी
e: In disguised unemployment, removing surplus workers does not reduce total output (marginal productivity = 0). Option A = Seasonal unemployment; Option C = Frictional unemployment; Option D = Structural/Technological unemployment.
qe: What is "Disguised Unemployment" (प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी), widely observed in Indian agriculture?
oe: Unemployment caused by seasonal gap between sowing and harvesting
More workers engaged in a task than actually needed, so marginal productivity of extra workers is zero
Temporary job loss while switching from one job to another
Unemployment caused by automation replacing factory workers

q: भुगतान संतुलन (Balance of Payments) लेखांकन में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा लेन-देन "पूँजी खाते" (Capital Account) के बजाय "चालू खाते" (Current Account) में दर्ज किया जाता है?
o: विदेशों में कार्यरत भारतीय श्रमिकों द्वारा भेजा गया विप्रेषण/रेमिटेंस
e: Current Account includes Merchandise Trade (Visible), Services (Invisible), Income, and Unilateral Transfers (Remittances/Grants). FDI, FII/FPI, and External Borrowings belong to the Capital Account.
qe: In balance of payments accounting, which of the following transactions is recorded under the "Current Account" rather than the "Capital Account"?
oe: Remittances sent home by Indian workers abroad

q: सामान्य कमरे के तापमान (25°C) पर कौन-सी धातु द्रव (Liquid) अवस्था में पाई जाती है?
e: Mercury (Hg, atomic number 80) is the only metal that is liquid at standard room temperature (Gallium & Caesium melt slightly above room temp ~28–30°C). Exam Boosters: (1) Bromine (Br) is the only non-metal that is liquid at room temperature.
qe: Which metal is found in the LIQUID state at normal room temperature (25°C)?

q: रात्रि में तारों के टिमटिमाने (twinkling of stars) का कारण कौन-सी वायुमंडलीय प्रकाशिक घटना है?
e: Starlight passes through atmospheric layers of continuously changing density and refractive index, bending repeatedly (atmospheric refraction) and causing stars to appear to twinkle. Planets are much closer (extended sources), so variations average out and they do not twinkle.
qe: Which atmospheric phenomenon causes the apparent twinkling of stars at night?

q: इंटरनेट एड्रेसिंग और ICT में "DNS" (डोमेन नेम सिस्टम) का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
o: मैलवेयर हेतु डाउनलोड ईमेल अटैचमेंट स्कैन करना
मानव-पठनीय डोमेन नामों को संख्यात्मक IP पतों में अनुवादित करना
बैंडविड्थ बचाने हेतु वीडियो स्ट्रीम संपीड़ित करना
वाई-फाई नेटवर्क पर स्थानीय प्रिंटर कतार प्रबंधित करना
e: DNS acts as the "phonebook of the Internet", resolving domain names into numerical IPv4/IPv6 addresses so browsers can connect to web servers.
qe: In internet addressing and ICT, what is the primary function of "DNS" (Domain Name System)?
oe: Scanning downloaded email attachments for malware
Translating human-readable domain names (like upsssc.gov.in) into numerical IP addresses
Compressing high-definition video streams for bandwidth saving
Managing local printer queues over Wi-Fi networks
